portraits: The 96-pixel faces are the ones that finally read as real, cute people: you can see the lashes, the light in the eyes and the shape of the lips. B is the same drawing at today's size, if you'd rather change less.
horses: A big, gentle draught horse with feathered hooves, saddlebags and a little swinging lantern. It has the clearest, most charming shape from every side, and it suits a cosy village.
dragons: You said the dragons felt small and cute rather than majestic: this one is about three of you long, with huge wings and a full wingbeat, and it still reads clearly from every side.
gloopgarr: The most fun to fight and the easiest to read: the pink stands out against the green bog, and his swallowed loot spills out when he splits.
grimjaw: He stays a real wolf leading his moss-wolf pack, and the white mane and the broken spear tell his story at a glance, even at night.
wyrm: His head opens into crystal petals just before he sprays shards, so you see the attack coming, and he matches the geodes he drops.
home_jasmine: Honey, baking and bears in one warm room: the bread oven, the honey hutch, and Sir Bartholomew hugging a honey pot. It's the most Jasmine of the three.
home_amara: A cosy attic under the stars, with a round moon window, a cork board of constellations tied with red string, and a hammock. It has the most of her nerdy personality, and it glows at night.
rare_observatory: It makes the “Sunken” in its name real: a half-drowned star chart with glinting tide pools and drifting moon jellies. C is the showpiece if you'd like drama.
rare_crystal: The liveliest fairy garden: a brook, a little waterfall spring and glowing crystal lilies. In B and C each flower's colour also matches the gem it gives you.
